This manual describes four ways to submit a dataset to BigPicture. Each ends
with a validated dataset uploaded to the BigPicture archive.

The manual describes metadata v3 (`3.0.0`). For what changed since v2, see the
[MetaFleX changelog](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bigpicture-metaflex/blob/v3.0.0/CHANGELOG.md)
and the [bigpicture-metadata-interface upgrade notes](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bigpicture-metadata-interface/blob/v3.0.0/UPGRADING.md).

## Before you start

### Access

All submission paths, expect for the `metadata submission`, uses private BigPicture
GitHub repositories, and the `bp-submission-pipeline` also pulls private
container images. Your GitHub account must be granted access to them before you
start. Request it via the [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}}).

Without access, signing in with GitHub still succeeds, but cloning fails with
"repository not found" or "access denied", and links to the private
repositories show a 404 page.

### Test in staging

BigPicture has two environments: staging for testing, and production for the
archive. Submit a test dataset with a small number of slides to staging first.
See [Do a staging run first](bp-submission-pipeline/run-submission.qmd#do-a-staging-run-first).

{{< include /datasets/submission/_staging-warning.qmd >}}

### Production

Uploading to production requires a signed Terms of Use and separate production
credentials from NBIS. See
[Prepare for production](bp-submission-pipeline/prepare-for-production.qmd).

## Choose a submission path

| Path | Choose this if… |
|------|-----------------|
| [**1. bp-submission-pipeline**](bp-submission-pipeline/prerequisites.qmd) | You want a guided set-up: the pipeline installs and connects the components for you. |
| [**2. Direct components**](direct-components/index.qmd) | You already run the components yourself and want to connect them your own way. |
| [**3. Metadata submission**](metadata-submitter/prerequisites.qmd) | You have the metadata XML files ready and want to submit them yourself through the SD Submit API. |
| [**4. Direct upload (sda-cli)**](direct-upload/prerequisites.qmd) | You're comfortable on the command line and don't need a curation UI. |

Paths 1 and 2 include the curation UI ([Slidetap](../../services/slidetap.qmd)),
a browser interface for reviewing and correcting metadata before submission.
